funding.supported_assets_note: Spends stablecoins (EURe/GBPe/USDCe) 1:1 from a Safe smart account on Gnosis Chain that the user controls.

variants.region_label: Europe (EEA, UK, CH) + selected other countries

eligibility.usage_note: Source lists 35 countries of residency by name (no ISO codes; mapping is ours). Brazil: cards issued only through partner PicNic. France: residents of French overseas territories are not served. Card use is blocked in 22 sanctioned countries/regions. 'Coming soon' (not available): AU, JP, MX, PH, TH, SG. Lists are stated as subject to change and carry no date.

kyc.stages_note: KYC in the app before the card is issued: government photo ID from the country of residence, proof of address issued within 3 months (strict document rules), liveness selfie, smartphone only; sanctions/PEP screening; manual review possible. Brazil: RG/CNH + CPF.

fees.conditions: Free shipping of the physical card. Replacement (lost/stolen) 4.99 EURe/GBPe/USDCe incl. shipping.
No added fee from Gnosis Pay; Visa's exchange rate applies at purchase.
Up to 5 free withdrawals or 200 EURe/GBPe/USDCe per month, whichever first; then 2% per withdrawal. ATM operator fees may apply.

rewards.conditions: Interim programme: 1% with ≥0.1 GNO held in the Card Safe (2%/3%/4% at 1/10/100 GNO; +1% with OG NFT). Weekly spend caps $250–$1,250 (recorded here as a monthly EUR approximation of the lowest cap; see evidence). Paid weekly in GNO. ENDED 2026-01-31; successor 'partner-led' programmes not documented on the pages read.

evidence.title: Gnosis Pay — company site (footer legal text, features)
evidence.excerpt: 'The Gnosis Pay Debit Card issued by Monavate Limited'; self-custodial via Safe smart accounts; integrated Sumsub verification. Page is partner-oriented; no consumer fees or rewards stated.

evidence.title: Supported countries for Gnosis Pay services (help centre)
evidence.excerpt: 35 supported countries of residency for ordering the card (EEA members, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, Switzerland, UK, Argentina, Brazil via PicNic, Colombia); 22 restricted countries for usage; 6 'coming soon'. No date; subject to change.

evidence.title: Fees and limits (help centre)
evidence.excerpt: No purchase transaction fees; no added FX fee (Visa rate); card order and shipping free; replacement 4.99; ATM 5 free or 200/month then 2%; daily spend 8,000 rolling, single 5,000; ATM daily 500, single 250. Monthly fees and top-up fees not stated.

evidence.title: Interim cashback programme 9 Nov 2025 – 31 Jan 2026 (help centre)
evidence.excerpt: Rates 1%/2%/3%/4% at 0.1/1/10/100 GNO; +1% OG NFT; weekly spend caps $250/$375/$500/$1,250; paid weekly in GNO; funded by Gnosis Ltd. Successor 'partner-led incentive programmes' announced without details.

evidence.title: GIP-110 cashback programme (help centre)
evidence.excerpt: Page titled 'current cashback programme' but notice says GIP-110 has ended. Same GNO tiers, weekly caps €5,000/£4,500/$5,500.
evidence.contradiction_note: Self-contradictory page (current vs ended). Treated as ended; no current cashback programme is established.

evidence.title: KYC verification guide (help centre)
evidence.excerpt: Government photo ID issued in the country of residence (passport, national ID, driving licence region-dependent, residence permit); proof of address <3 months (no neobank statements, no utility-style mobile/internet bills, no screenshots); liveness selfie; must be done on a smartphone; SumSub. Brazil: RG/CNH + CPF. Watchlist (sanctions/PEP) checks; manual review possible.

changelog.reason: Initial record from official help-centre articles (single read; second read required before publication).

Second independent read on 2026-10-28 of the fees/limits article and the supported-countries article: all figures and the 35-country list confirmed. KYC requirements now sourced from the help-centre KYC guide (previously a hypothesis from the company site).

editorial.summary: Self-custodial Visa debit card spending stablecoins from a Safe smart account; free to order, no FX fee from the provider, 2% ATM fee after a monthly allowance. No current cashback programme is documented: the last one ended on 31 January 2026.
good_for: Residents of the EEA, UK, Switzerland and listed Latin-American countries who want to keep custody of their funds
Spending stablecoins without a provider FX mark-up
not_for: Anyone counting on cashback today (none documented)
Residents of countries outside the 35 listed
watch_outs: Monthly/account fees are not stated anywhere read — treated as unknown, not free.
The GIP-110 page calls itself 'current' while stating the programme ended; we treat cashback as ended until a new programme is published.
On-chain transfers into the Safe cost gas (xDai) and may involve exchange fees not covered here.
